Marie Curie, a Polish-born physicist and chemist, was awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1903, along with her husband Pierre Curie and Henri Becquerel, for their pioneering work on radioactivity.

Later, in 1911, Marie Curie was awarded the Nobel Prize in Chemistry, becoming the first person to win two Nobel Prizes in different fields
